decision: Add DAAX_EXTRA_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: a comma-separated list of exact https origins admitted by isAllowedOrigin (server/config/origin-allowlist.ts), the single decision point for the middleware CSRF check and the terminal WS upgrade. Entries are parsed with URL, host lowercased and default :443 dropped, then matched by exact string equality. An invalid entry (non-https, path, trailing slash, query, fragment, credentials, wildcard, unparseable) throws naming the entry; the parse runs at boot in instrumentation.ts and server/terminal-server.ts and first thing in every isAllowedOrigin call. Empty entries are ignored; unset/empty keeps the built-in list unchanged.
rationale: A second, host-mode daax served at https://daax-host.<host>.poley.dev (dist-agent ADR 0026 section 4) is outside the daax.<host>.poley.dev pattern, so every browser write and terminal upgrade from it is refused. Rewriting Origin at the proxy was rejected because it defeats CSRF for every caller. Failing loudly instead of dropping a bad entry means an operator typo is visible at startup rather than as silent 403s.
alternatives: Widen the regex to daax[-\w]*.<host>.poley.dev (rejected: admits names nobody declared); wildcard entries (rejected: out of scope, re-creates suffix matching); http for *.localhost entries (rejected: already covered by the built-in *.localhost rule).

decision: The boot-time DAAX_EXTRA_ALLOWED_ORIGINS check moves to assertExtraOriginsAtBoot (server/config/extra-origins-boot.ts), which logs the entry and calls process.exit(1) instead of throwing; both instrumentation.ts and server/terminal-server.ts call it. Entries whose URL.origin differs from the entry lowercased with a default :443 removed are refused.
rationale: Review found terminal-server.ts registers an uncaughtException handler before the parse, so the throw was logged and the process exited 0, leaving Next running without a terminal under concurrently. Exiting explicitly works regardless of handler order. The canonical-form check stops URL parsing from silently tidying a backslash, tab or empty userinfo into a different origin than the operator wrote.
alternatives: Move the parse above registerGlobalErrorHandlers (rejected: correctness would depend on statement order that a later edit can undo, and it does not cover instrumentation.ts).
